title: BillingSubscriptionResult
description: billing.subscription-result@1: answers about subscriptions on OpenVibe.Billing. POST /api/v1/subscriptions (201) → { subscription, entitlement, transaction }; POST /api/v1/subscriptions/:id/cancel → { subscription, provider_sync }; GET /api/v1/subscriptions?subscriber=&streamer=&status= → { subscriptions }; GET /api/v1/subscriptions/:id → { subscription, entitlement }.

entitlement.description: billing.entitlement@1 (the answer to POST /subscriptions carries the entitlement as booked).

provider_sync.description: not_needed, or how the provider was told.
